description: This file defines a service class 'DatetimeFormatDetector' for detecting and storing datetime formats in dataset columns within the Superset project. It includes methods for detecting formats for individual columns and all columns in a dataset, utilizing SQL queries and pandas-based detection.

classes.name: DatetimeFormatDetector
classes.description: A service class for detecting and storing datetime formats in dataset columns, with methods for individual and bulk detection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the detector with an optional sample size, defaulting to a config value or 1000.

methods.name: detect_column_format
methods.description: Detects the datetime format of a specific column in a dataset by querying sample data and analyzing it.

methods.name: detect_all_formats
methods.description: Detects datetime formats for all temporal columns in a dataset, optionally forcing re-detection.
